title: Unclear or inconsistent purpose
required_reference_topics: Eligible guidance only for independently supported subworkflows.
Independent facts for identifiable claims; no whole-conversation policy guessed from keywords.

check_conditions.procedure.information: Use a specific procedure branch only where the purpose and its conditions can actually be established. Assess prerequisites only for an independently supported action/branch; unknown requirements remain unresolved.
check_conditions.procedure.actions: Use a specific procedure branch only where the purpose and its conditions can actually be established. Assess only independently identifiable required actions; unrelated or empty action records do not define the workflow. Compare the recorded agreed operation here; required verification/eligibility/permission relationships remain in procedure.order_permission, and factual policy claims require independent eligible support in Answer support.
check_conditions.procedure.order_permission: Assess prerequisites only for an independently supported action/branch; unknown requirements remain unresolved. Assess only explicit permission/order requirements whose applicability and relevant events are independently supported.
check_conditions.completeness: Retain identifiable requests and clarify their uncertain targets without inventing a single coherent purpose. Assess responses to independently supported request parts; preserve contradictory or incomplete links.
check_conditions.completeness.promises_next_steps: Account only for identifiable requested outcomes; unsupported request/outcome boundaries stay unresolved. Identify actual clarification needs and supported pending commitments without inventing a repair to the dialogue.
check_conditions.communication-style: Judge specific observable wording only where surrounding context is sufficient.
check_conditions.answer-support: Independent references/records only for identifiable factual claims; no assumption that ambiguous dialogue is an Agent fault.

additional_interpretation_limits: Unclear is a recorded applicability problem, not a poor performance score. Preserve any independently assessable metrics.
